language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Welcome to my village!
Here in Alaska, our lives are fairly modern with satellite TV, internet, and snowmobiles.
Traditionally, we learned to survive off the land eating fish, berries, and moose which is something we still do today!
It’s very important here that we work together and share everything equally so that there’s always enough to go around.
Last week, my mother brought home 25 salmon berries and we had to share them.
Since there are five of us in our family, she gave one to each of us until they were all gone.
She counted out 1-2-3-4-5, then again to 10, then to 15, and then to 20, and finally to 25.
When she was done, each of us had five salmon berries.
That’s how you divide things so that everyone has a fair share.
Do you think you can help Cimeon divide other things into fair shares?
